data.name: Sumanta
data.gender_notes: Sumanta is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘suma’ which means ‘good’ and ‘anta’ which means ‘governance’. It signifies good governance, intelligent rule, and wise decision making. The name Sumanta carries the meaning “Good Governance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Sumanta usually hope their child will grow to embody good governance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the divine grace and wisdom of the gods, inspiring its bearer to lead a righteous and just life.
data.etymology: Sumanta belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good Governance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sumanta total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
